scenes.label: A tree by the sea
full: In Africa there is a big coconut tree.
It is next to the sea and a town.
easy: There is a big coconut tree.
It is next to the sea.

scenes.label: Sharing coconuts
full: Every day a monkey goes and eats its delicious coconuts.
Every day he gives some to a shark.
easy: The monkey eats coconuts every day.
He gives coconuts to the shark.

scenes.label: An invitation
full: One day, the shark says, "You are very nice to me."
"I would like to invite you to my house."
easy: The shark says, "You are very nice to me."

scenes.label: A ride on the shark
full: "But I don't go in the sea," says the monkey.
"No problem," says the shark.
"Jump on my back!"
The shark swims away with the monkey.
easy: The monkey gets on the shark's back.

scenes.label: The ill king
full: "At home our king is very ill," the shark says.
"He needs a monkey's heart to make him well!"

scenes.label: A clever idea
full: The monkey thinks for a moment.
"Oh, no!" he says.
"I haven't got my heart with me."
"When I go out I put my heart in the tree."
easy: He says, "My heart is in the tree."

scenes.label: Going back
full: "No problem," says the shark.
"Let's go back and get it!"

scenes.label: Jumping to safety
full: They go back to the tree and the monkey jumps off the shark's back.
"Wait here," says the monkey.
easy: They go back to the tree.

scenes.label: The shark waits
full: The shark waits and waits, and waits and waits.
"What are you doing?" the shark shouts.
"Let's go!"

scenes.label: The monkey escapes
full: "No way!" the monkey shouts back.
"You're not tricking me again!"
"I need my heart!"
And he runs away laughing.
easy: The monkey says, "No! I need my heart!"

questions.explanation: The tree is next to the sea and a town.

questions.text: What does the monkey give the shark?
questions.explanation: The monkey shares his delicious coconuts every day.

questions.text: Who invites the monkey to his house?
questions.explanation: The shark invites the monkey to his house.

questions.text: How does the monkey travel in the sea?
questions.explanation: The monkey rides on the shark's back.

questions.text: Why does the king want a heart?
questions.explanation: The king is ill. The shark says a monkey's heart can make him well.

questions.text: Is the monkey's heart really in the tree?
options: Yes, the shark put it there.
No, it is a clever trick.
questions.explanation: His heart is inside his body. He says it is in the tree so he can escape.

questions.text: Why does the monkey say "Wait here"?
options: He wants to visit the king.
questions.explanation: The monkey wants to stay safe in the tree.

questions.text: Are they still friends at the end?
questions.explanation: The shark tried to trick the monkey, so the monkey runs away.
